Reviewed on 2026-10-22. The first four notices reproduce upstream license files. Vercel declares MIT in its README and in several skill frontmatter headers; its repository has no standalone root license file, so its notice records that evidence and includes the standard MIT text without inventing an upstream copyright line. Preserve any attribution within individual files as well. Recheck sources and notices when updating skills.
